segments.text: [soft, slow, warm voice] [gentle canal water lapping] [softly] Let the body be supported. Imagine a moonlit canal beside you, smooth enough to carry a small paper boat.
[soft, slow, warm voice] Write a wish for yourself on the first boat: may I be protected from unnecessary harm... may I know friendship... may I rest when rest is needed.
[soft, slow, warm voice] Set the boat on the water. If self-kindness feels difficult, let the canal hold the wish until you are ready to receive it.
[soft, slow, warm voice] [soft paper folding] Fold another boat for someone you love. Picture their ordinary face, including the details that make them human rather than perfect.
[soft, slow, warm voice] May you be protected from unnecessary harm... may you know friendship... may you rest when rest is needed. Watch their boat join yours.
[soft, slow, warm voice] Now choose a person who usually stays at the edge of your attention. A stranger has a whole weather system of memories too.
[soft, slow, warm voice] Offer the same wishes and let a third boat drift into the silver current. No emotion is required; intention is enough for this moment.
[soft, slow, warm voice] If it feels possible, include someone with whom life is complicated. Keep your boundaries. Simply wish that suffering and confusion do not keep multiplying.
[soft, slow, warm voice] [reassuringly] You may skip anyone who makes the practice unsafe. Loving kindness includes the person sitting here, and that person is allowed to choose distance.
[soft, slow, warm voice] [faint river flowing] Imagine the canal widening into a river filled with paper lights. May all of us find safety... connection... and enough gentleness for the next step.
[soft, slow, warm voice] Let the river travel beyond imagination. Feel your hands, your breathing, and the quiet place where the boats began.
[soft, slow, warm voice] [softly] Open your eyes when ready. Keep one blank boat nearby for a kindness you have not thought of yet.
